info.name: Montran Corporate Payments Portal Account Information Consent API

items.docs: Creates a new PSD2 consent for account access (AISP) or payment initiation (PISP). The consent must be authorized by the payment service user (PSU) before it can be used. Supports Strong Customer Authentication (SCA) flows as required by PSD2.

params.name: consentId
params.description: Unique identifier of the PSD2 consent

items.docs: Retrieves the current status and details of a PSD2 consent. Used to check whether the consent has been authorized by the PSU and remains valid for use.

params.name: consentId
params.description: Unique identifier of the PSD2 consent

items.docs: Revokes an existing PSD2 consent. Once revoked, the consent can no longer be used for account access or payment initiation.
